sloka: यथा विजृंभते सिंहो विवृते गिरि गह्वरे ।मारुतस्य औरसः पुत्रः तथा संप्रति जृंभते ॥४-६७-६॥
transliteration: yathā vijṛṁbhate siṁho vivṛte giri gahvare ।mārutasya aurasaḥ putraḥ tathā saṁprati jṛṁbhate ॥4-67-6॥

translations.english: Just as a lion grown in a mountain cave stretches its body, the Windgod's son stretched (his limbs) at that time.
